[b][u]Part 1: The destruction of Casrine[/u][/b]

In 1789, a great power had arisen in Vespuria: The Great Empire of Casrine. They were known as ruthless barbarians wanting to take control of the entirety of Erene. They had already conquered several nations with little force, and were in the process of taking control of many more. Their leader was the Holy Emperor of Laetitia. Every nation in Erene was wanting to destroy this Empire. So, the nations allied together and made a plan to take control. Their plan was to have one of their military members pose as a guard for the emperor, with a gun over his shoulder. When he crossed paths with the emperor, he would shoot him with his gun, and then sacrifice his life dying to kill the emperor. So, they executed the plan and it worked! He shot the emperor, and he died about 30 minutes later.

After that, the empire went into chacos. Military members did not know who and when to fight, and they ended up fighting each other, effectively wiping out the whole empire. The capital was taken less than a year later. Then, a dispute began about who should have the small amount of territory left. The piece of land left was bordering the ocean in far east Vespuria. After a while of debating, a new country was born in 1832, by the name of Vermont.

[b][u]Part 2: The development of Vermont and the Communist takeover[/u][/b]

Vermont grew to have over 38 million people. They had an organized constitution, a President, and a Congress. When 1904 came, it was time for another election. A man by the name of Rusckas Chrivosky was running for the Peoples Socialist Party. He won by a very close 50.01% (about 19,003,800 votes). On his first day, he abolished the constitution and the congress. He made a new communist system and declared himself as supreme leader. He developed very close relations with other communist nations. The communist regime lived for a very long time.

[b]This is all for the expansion, but there will be more for my next expansion![/b]

[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;59980854][spoiler=[b]-Hunting the Hydronian Fleet-[/b]]

Even as the enemy fleet attempts to flee, the Reichswehr keeps chasing. The DF-26B missile systems allow the Reichswehr to pursue the fleet much of the way during their retreat back to Hydronia. These anti-naval ballistic missile systems reenter and are built to strike their targets (the one remaining carrier) at mach 8 leaving almost zero chance for interception. 

However, the radar homing interceptors of the Hydronian fleet would face even more challenges from the DF-26B. The MIRV capabilities would allow the missile to split into multiple warheadsincluding active warheads on top of decoys to maximize the chances of interception. At the same time the missiles spray chaff as they reenter to create multiple decoys on the radar interceptor targeting systems. 

Their ECCM capabilities onboard help to prevent spoofing as the datalinks change weakened frequencies rapidly to both avoid detection and jamming. Cooler exhaust gases help to avoid infrared detection as flares are sprayed upon reentering to create multiple decoys. The already weakened remaining carrier and its jets would unlikely be able to survive the strike. 

Submarines from the TKS Graf Sachsen strike group hunt the remaining weakened fleet as they flee. TKS Büdingen and the TKS Eisenstadt nuclear submarines move stealthily through the deep water, maintaining significant distance from the enemy's passive sonar and ASW. 

Once within range(900 km) the two fire their payloads of 154 Donnerkeil MSTs each from shallow waters before quickly diving to deep depths and pulling back. These missiles eject using their solid propellant before switching to turbofans to fly at subsonic speeds over the water to avoid radar detection. A datalink, which uses a weakened signal that constantly switches frequencies, provides mission data to guide the missile. On top of this the missile possesses its own independent radar and IIR. The missile is also capable of dodging to avoid interceptors.[/spoiler] 

[spoiler=[b]-Over Hydronian Skies-[/b]]

Once the Gunslingers had been slammed towards the four squadrons of jets, the J-15Es along with ship radar continued to watch the situation unfold. In last ditch evasive maneuvers the fighter jets would begin to break up, supposedly to prevent target clumping. However, the Hydronians hadnt realized the AAMs werent proximity fused but rather meant to directly hit each individual aircraft. 

Steady datalink connections along with onboard weak frequency, constantly hopping radar would hunt down each aircraft individually, their evasive maneuvers having little impact on the operation. With those countermeasures it would be unlikely that the four squadrons would be able to make it out of the air alive. Whether they were clumped together or not wouldnt matter, the missiles were tracking the individual aircraft for air-to-air kills. 

The SM-6 anti-air missiles aboard the CSGs guided missile cruisers would hunt down the enemy aircraft as well. These missiles which reached speeds over mach 4 would be extremely hard to intercept. 

Although the Kaiserreich had destroyed the majority of the Hydronian anti-air, a select batch of Hydronian anti-air had been activated, launching missiles towards the Reichswehr jets. However, the long-range distance maintained by the J-15Es gives the fleet plenty of time to intercept the incoming anti-air missiles using their KKVs. The majority of missiles are shot down before reaching the aircraft but one jet is shot down with the pilot successfully ejecting and later being picked up by helicopter. 

The rest of the jets would exploit the activation of the air defenses. Hydronian anti-air had exposed its locations once again with activation and now the rest of the jets moved to counterattack. The REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles would be used once again. The missiles, locking onto even momentary activation of radar would home in on their locations. Its small cross section and small payload would allow it to move extremely quickly to avoid interception as well as its cross section being nearly undetectable to radar. Its ability to go faster than mach 2 would allow it to avoid most interception systems. 

However, this wouldnt be the only attack on Hydronian anti-air. The J-16CJs would launch their long-range loitering munition drones. These drones, used to devastating effect in the Sikirskian air, would target even anti-air located far behind enemy lines. The drones also known as the Sturmgeier possess a range of over 1,000 km. They stay low to the ground so as to avoid radar detection. Once they detect their targets they dive onto them at hypersonic speeds, delivering their explosive payloads. Due to their fire and forget capabilities these systems are fully autonomous, allowing them to bypass enemy jamming.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]-Airstrike-[/b]]

The majority of Donnerkeil cruise missiles are able to get through the Hydronian anti-air using their terrain tracking capabilities. They strike a wide range of targets, mostly the Hydronian air systems. The strike including over 300 cruise missiles works to completely cripple Hydronias ability to wage air war. Runways are hit to destroy aircraft on the ground and prevent them from taking off and landing. Critical aviation fuel stores are hit as well along with command centers across the country. Arms depots are slammed into to prevent the enemy from reloading its systems while they also take out critical infrastructure including power generation and strategic factories. 

While the Hydronian air systems are still reeling from an incoming drone and missile attack, the CSG fires yet another salvo to destroy even more of Hydronias war fighting capabilities. Donnerkeils rush over the sea to hit coastal defences to prevent defenses against the CSG. On top of this a wide variety of transportation infrastructure would be attacked. Railroads, bridges and tunnels would be struck to halt the rapid transportation of troops and reduce enemy response time. The fuel vital to the war effort would be targets as well. Pipelines and oil production across the country would be hit along with strategic oil reserves.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]-At Sea-[/b]]

The initial hypersonic streak had wrought massive damage upon the enemy. A total twelve ships had been forced out of the battle including seven sunk and five heavily damaged. Earlier successful strikes against Hydronian drydocks would make repair of damaged ships near impossible. In response to the strikes the Hydronians had continued to retreat. However, they were still well in range of the hypersonic sea-skimming missiles with the Kaiserliche Marine responding by firing another salvo of over 100 missiles towards the enemy. 

The enemy counterattack would meet the formidable defenses provided by the fleet. Phased array radars detect the missiles at long ranges, allowing the computer systems to rapidly identify, track and prioritize them. First the fleet uses its SEWIP soft-kill capabilities. Jamming and spoofing is used to degrade the enemy's missile tracking systems to cause them to change course or simply stop tracking the fleet. Nulka decoys are fired off the ships, mimicking the signature of surface craft, leading the missiles away. 

At long-range the SM-6 missiles intercept the remaining interceptors while the SM-3 intercepts those that make it to medium range. The point defense wouldnt be required for full interception. In the end the majority of missiles wouldnt hit the fleet with minor damage sustained by one of the cargo ships. Deploying the Xhawk-6s to strike the fleet would be a mistake. The significantly longer range of the SM-6 would mean dozens of datalink guided hypersonic missiles would rocket toward the aircraft likely meaning their destruction. [/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Protection of the homeland - continuation[/b]]
As the missiles continue towards the jets, despite the evasive manoeuvres, the Xhawk-5s release all of their interceptor missiles, then dive down and attempt to safely land. Before the missiles could teach them. In addition to this, the backup air defences would once again release their chaff-spraying homing interception missiles, this time in far greater numbers, just before they were hit by the Kaiserreich and rendered non-functional. These missiles would aim to take down the SM-6s headed towards the landing aircraft so that the jets can land safely.

The drones would be dealt with by Hydronias own. A huge swarm of cheap suicide drones would fly towards the Kaiserreichs and crash into them, creating explosions that would take out nearby drones as well. Hydronias drones would also attempt to swarm around the keiserreich jets.

The cruise missiles would pose a large threat to Hydronia. There capabilities to go undetected would give them a huge advantage. As the missiles flew over Hydronias inland more advanced defence systems, Hydronias finest missiles would be launched. The missiles would be able to be detected at this small interval as they flee over, then the interceptors would reach speeds of Mach 3 to catch up to the cruise missiles and take them down. Loses would still be taken, but thanks to Hydronias infrastructure mainly being located in the south, it didnt disrupt the war effort by an unprecedented amount.

Hydronias coastal defences would take heavy hits, now unprotected by the antiair, but thanks to the earlier mentioned inland defence systems, the missiles would be unable to reach any of Hydronias main oil supplies or infrastructure, those again being located in the south.

The Keiserreich fleet defences would be successful, with Xhawk-6s being forced to take evasive action and return, or get hit. The 100 missiles would also hit the fleet, dealing heavy damage, but before they did, the Hydronian ships had deployed stealth submarines deep underwater. The submarines, armed with torpedoes, would take the dangerous action of moving underneath the kairserreichs ships and launching high-speed torpedoes. Due to their location directly underneath the ships, these torpedoes would be hard to detect and intercept. The submarines would then continue to weave in and out of the fleet, striking each ship.
[/spoiler]
